_comment: Stage hooks of a run with a per-run TeamLead (the ask channel, .agents/reference/team-lead.md §6). Not a session profile: the runner materialises it at every stage launch into <clone>/.agents/team/stage-hooks.settings.json ({{MAIN}} = the main checkout, every ask entry — the commands that set TEAM_ASK_TIMEOUT={{TIMEOUT}} — gets the measured ask wait as its timeout and {{TIMEOUT}}; the 600 there is a placeholder; {{SEAL}} = the sha256 of the main checkout's .agents/team/clearance.json at this launch, or off — #323) and passes it with --settings.
